PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE IV OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection
Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
20th March, 1998]
No. S.Legis:1(4)/98, dated
20-3-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:---
1. (1) Short title and
commencement.--This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Wildlife Protection
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Substitution of Section--17

ORDINANCE IV OF 1998
SINDH WILDLIFE
PROTECTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE IV OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Wildlife Protection
Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
20th March, 1998]
No. S.Legis:1(4)/98, dated
20-3-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:---
2. In the Sindh Widlife
Protection Ordinance, 1972, in section 17, after subsection (1), the following
new subsection shall be inserted:--
"(1-A) Amendment of section
17 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1972.--, Notwithstanding the provisions of
subsection (1), whoever hunts (1) rabbit or (2) deer, hoodder or para. or (3)
Sindh ibex or wildsheep in contravention of the provisions of this Ordinance
shall respectively be punished (1) with a fine of one hundred thousand rupees
or with imprisonment of three months, (2) with a fine of one hundred fifty
thousand rupees or with imprisonment of six months or (3) with a fine of three
hundred thousand rupees or with imprisonment of nine months. ".
